title: Passing Yards Speed Step 1 Bottleneck Isolation
scope: Verifier-only bottleneck isolation for the selected-quarterback Passing Yards page. No product, model, data, math, sportsbook, router-owner, V77, or app changes.
root_cause: The selected-QB route waits for the full frozen upstream analysis pipeline and then composes/serializes an extremely large selected-QB HTML document before the detail root becomes usable. Existing certified Step 8 evidence recorded ~43.8 MB selected-QB HTML and public readiness of roughly 35-43 seconds. V59 includes all heavy support payloads in the selected page, and V67 adds the same deep evidence again as a second presentation surface. This makes initial usability depend on completion of the giant full-detail render.
next_patch: Step 2 will add an immediate lightweight selected-QB first-paint shell before the unchanged frozen full analysis render, using bounded cached summary data when available and a generic verified loading shell otherwise.
